interpretation_limits: The generic B601 name and accepted-URDF label do not distinguish DM from another motor/mechanical revision.
Missing DM metadata in this bounded chain is not proof that the existing model is RS or mismatched; the variant remains unknown.
STEP HEADER writer name and timestamp are export metadata, not supplier model revision evidence.
Source hashes inherited from a contract establish declared file identity only; this check does not recompute large STEP hashes or validate their BRep/native import.
User confirmation of electrical variant does not retroactively prove matching CAD, mounting holes, connector location, mass or as-built compatibility.

Bind the actual shipped DM mechanical revision or a supplier-confirmed mechanical ICD.
Then compare named base/joint/gripper interfaces, motor housings and connector/cable positions against the retained LINKLOCAL geometry; this comparison has not been performed here.
